reproduced_failure_model: Layer 1 trigger: fingerprint-driven authority can fail to wake when pull_request.paths is narrower than the fingerprint surface.
Layer 2 obligation: a cancellable classifier that examines only newest HEAD can erase earlier relevant PR changes before substantive admission.
Layer 3 satisfaction: workflow-level success with skipped result jobs is routing evidence only, never substantive evidence.
required_repairs: Use merge-base(PR base, exact head)..exact head for PR candidate impact; preserve rename source+destination names.
Reuse the canonical release fingerprint's recursive-glob semantics instead of fnmatch reinterpretation.
Ensure fingerprint-driven authority wakes on every relevant candidate; avoid a narrower hand-maintained trigger surface.
Add a temporal regression: relevant A queued/cancelled before admission then irrelevant B must still carry the unmet obligation.
Keep result-bearing jobs exact-SHA and non-cancelling.
Converge later to semantic evidence fingerprint plus durable substantive satisfaction so irrelevant commits can reuse a valid receipt without rerunning it.
promotion_boundary: No review thread resolves until the corresponding source repair and regression evidence are landed on the reviewed PR head or a legitimate successor.
